lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 8-10 horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in a staggered grid posterior to the gill slits. The blobs exhibit higher density in the anterior region and transition to larger, more discrete centroids in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a lattice-like structure of anchor nodes across the mid-to-posterior flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with specular highlights on the dorsal edge and casting shadows on the ventral edge.
